metadata.period_definition: Radial: median successive R-minimum spacing; vertical: median successive Z-maximum spacing; >=3 extrema required. Azimuthal: window duration / unwrapped turns, >=2 turns required. Unavailable values are null.
metadata.Lz_convention: X*Vy-Y*Vx in inherited Astropy axes; prograde solar rotation has negative Lz

adopted_parameters.assumption: Adopted Galactic modelling assumptions, not measured properties of Stock 2.
adopted_parameters.convention: Astropy v4.0 parameter set, explicitly frozen for Project 04A

galcen_coord.meaning: Adopted ICRS direction of Galactic centre

galcen_distance.meaning: Distance from the solar-system origin to the Galactic centre, including solar height

galcen_v_sun.meaning: Solar velocity relative to Galactic centre, in adopted Cartesian X,Y,Z axes; includes total azimuthal motion

roll.meaning: Additional roll relative to Astropy's Galactic-plane orientation

z_sun.meaning: Height of the solar-system origin above the adopted Galactic midplane

reference.convention: Astropy Galactocentric, right-handed, Galactic centre at origin. The solar-system origin is at negative X, Y=0, positive Z=z_sun; +X points from the solar projection through the centre toward the opposite side. +Y is approximately Galactic l=90 degrees and the adopted solar rotation direction; +Z is toward the northern side of the adopted midplane. Velocities are positive along the same axes. Solar height induces Astropy's small frame tilt. All five public frame parameters are explicit; no default parameter values are used.
reference.cylindrical_convention: R=hypot(X,Y); phi=atan2(Y,X) in [-180,180] degrees, increasing from +X toward +Y. e_R=(X/R,Y/R,0) points outward in the plane; e_phi=(-Y/R,X/R,0) is increasing azimuth; e_Z=(0,0,1). v_R=(X*Vx+Y*Vy)/R; v_phi=(-Y*Vx+X*Vy)/R; cylindrical v_z=vz_gc_kms. With Sun at negative X and positive Vy, increasing azimuth opposes adopted local solar rotation: solar v_phi is negative. R=0 has undefined phi,v_R,v_phi (NaN).
reference.axis_transform: Astropy transform of +/-1 kpc positions along stored axis; difference cancels translation. No PCA refit.
reference.reference_columns: x_gc_kpc etc in this one-row product are the transformed fixed Project 03C reference, not sample medians.
reference.reference_definition: Existing homogenized_class == C; component-wise median of all complete Cartesian position vectors and, separately, all complete Cartesian velocity vectors. No clipping, quality selection, iteration, or new membership inference.
reference.observable_definition: ICRS back-transform of fixed 03C Cartesian reference; pmra includes cos(dec).
reference.present_epoch: t=0 is the inherited Gaia DR3 reference state, not propagated to execution date

integration.initialization: independent past and future integrations each start from supplied t=0 state
integration.internal_step: adaptive; output cadence is not internal solver step
